name: CedarLoom core
description: The rules, templates and default profile that ship with CedarLoom.

rules/global.md.description: Global rules: secrets, confirmation, assumptions, the minimum change, the check that proves done

rules/questions.md.description: Owner questions as issues in the hub repository

rules/project.md.description: Project rules: the workflow skill, questions, failed checks, best practice

rules/family.md.description: Rules for every project's AGENTS.md: checks before a push, CI, dependencies, comments, names, UI, writing

rules/tests.md.description: When to add a test, what never to test, coverage and mutation testing

rules/local.md.description: Where issues and owner questions go: the hub repository

templates/issue-tracker.md.description: docs/agents/issue-tracker.md: no issues in a product repository

templates/triage-labels.md.description: docs/agents/triage-labels.md: the labels live in the hub

templates/memory.description: The memory repository's first files: README.md, INDEX.md, the pull request template

templates/workflows.description: An export folder with the default workflow feature: cedarloom import it, then cedarloom workflows install feature

profiles/default.json.description: The CedarLoom way: every part on three levels
